name: Selected 3-of-6 strategy
selection_basis: Retained signal/selection version originally chosen by highest observed portfolio return, with allocation increased to 100% at user request. Final period previously inspected.
allocation: Normalize pass_count / mean(p over all six training periods), using only selected pairs. Missing p=1, denominator floor=1e-6; no pair allocation cap. Weights fixed before trading; unused pair budgets remain cash.
